description: Single source of truth for the AI operational assistant brain. All other artifacts (LLM prompt, parser JS, DB queries, test cases) are generated or validated from this file.

validation_rules: IF task_action missing OR task_action.title empty → clarify('missing_task_action_title_for_create_task')
IF task_action.priority not in VALID_TASK_PRIORITIES → set null → apply default 'normal'
IF task_action.due_type missing → infer: due_at present → 'datetime', due_date present → 'date', else → 'flexible'
IF due_type='date' → set due_at=null (mutual exclusion)
IF due_type='datetime' → set due_date=null (mutual exclusion)
ALWAYS set reminder_action=null (create_task must not carry reminder data)
create_task.response_pattern: Confirmation with task title and due info

update_task.description: Update an existing task (priority, title, dates)
validation_rules: IF task_action missing → clarify('missing_task_action_for_update_task')
Semantic matching by title is allowed (id not required)
update_task.db_action: UPDATE tasks WHERE id OR title ILIKE

validation_rules: IF task_action missing → clarify('missing_task_action_for_complete_task')

cancel_task.description: Permanently delete a task (physical DELETE FROM). Supports single (by id or title) and batch (by filter_scope).
validation_rules: IF task_action missing → clarify('missing_task_action_for_cancel_task')
IF task_action.id AND task_action.title both missing AND filter_scope missing → clarify('need_id_or_title_or_filter_for_delete')
Semantic matching by title is allowed (id not required)
IF filter_scope provided AND no id AND no title → batch delete matching tasks
LIMIT 50 rows per batch delete for safety
cancel_task.db_action: DELETE FROM tasks WHERE tenant_id AND (id match OR title ILIKE match OR filter_scope match) RETURNING deleted rows
cancel_task.response_pattern: Confirmation of deletion with count and titles

validation_rules: IF task_action missing → create with filter_scope from inferFilterScopeFromMessage()
IF task_action.filter_scope missing → infer from raw_user_message
list_tasks.db_action: SELECT FROM tasks WHERE filter_scope conditions

validation_rules: IF reminder_action missing OR title empty OR remind_at empty → clarify('missing_reminder_action_for_create_reminder')
IF task_action also present AND no task language in message → clarify('create_reminder_should_not_also_create_task')
IF valid → set task_action=null, task_fallback_rules=[]
IF reminder_action missing → clarify('missing_reminder_action_for_update_reminder')

cancel_reminder.description: Permanently delete a reminder (physical DELETE FROM). Supports single (by id or title) and batch (by filter_scope).
validation_rules: IF reminder_action missing → clarify('missing_reminder_action_for_cancel_reminder')
IF reminder_action.id AND reminder_action.title both missing AND filter_scope missing → clarify('need_id_or_title_or_filter_for_delete')
Semantic matching by title is allowed (id not required)
IF filter_scope provided AND no id AND no title → batch delete matching reminders
LIMIT 50 rows per batch delete for safety
cancel_reminder.db_action: DELETE FROM reminders WHERE tenant_id AND (id match OR title ILIKE match OR filter_scope match) RETURNING deleted rows
cancel_reminder.response_pattern: Confirmation of deletion with count and titles

validation_rules: IF reminder_action missing → create with filter_scope from inferFilterScopeFromMessage()
IF reminder_action.filter_scope missing → infer from raw_user_message
list_reminders.db_action: SELECT FROM reminders WHERE filter_scope conditions

validation_rules: IF memory_action missing OR query empty → clarify('missing_memory_action_query_for_search_memory')
search_memory.db_action: SELECT FROM rag_memories ORDER BY embedding <=> query_vector

validation_rules: CLEAN all action payloads to null (task_action, reminder_action, memory_action, improvement_request)
CLEAN task_fallback_rules to []

save_improvement_request.description: User suggests a feature or improvement
validation_rules: IF improvement_request missing OR requested_feature empty → clarify('missing_improvement_request_feature')
CLEAN all action payloads to null
CLEAN task_fallback_rules to []

due_type.inference: IF due_at → datetime, IF due_date → date, ELSE flexible

category_filter.description: Optional RAG category to narrow search scope

descriptions.business_profile: Info about tenant businesses — services, locations, capacity, pricing, team size
descriptions.customer_market: Client segments, seasonal patterns, demand, competition, market behavior
descriptions.growth_context: Revenue, goals, expansion plans, investments, KPIs
descriptions.entrepreneur_profile: Owner's skills, schedule, communication style, decision patterns
descriptions.relationship_history: Interactions with specific contacts — deals, disputes, reliability, notes
descriptions.operational_patterns: Recurring processes, workflows, habits, common issues, solutions that worked
descriptions.preferences: How the entrepreneur prefers things — communication, tools, timing, formats
descriptions.constraints: Limitations — budget caps, time restrictions, legal, regulatory, physical

memory_writes.validation: Filter strategy — invalid items removed silently, valid preserved. Items with category not in valid values are dropped.

disambiguation.description: When both task and reminder language detected in raw_user_message, prefer TASK. Transfer data from reminder_action to task_action if needed.
disambiguation.rule: IF hasTaskLanguage AND hasReminderLanguage → flip create_reminder to create_task, build task_action from reminder_action, clean reminder_action

task_language_patterns.description: Patterns that indicate task preference in Romanian

reminder_language_patterns.description: Patterns that indicate reminder preference in Romanian

filter_scope_inference.description: When LLM does not provide filter_scope for list_tasks/list_reminders, parser infers from raw_user_message. Order matters — first match wins.

old_contract_fields.description: Reject LLM output that contains fields from old contract versions

invalid_intent.description: Reject if intent not in valid intents list

output_envelope.description: Parser wraps decision with tenant context for downstream nodes

generated_artifacts: LLM system prompt — intent instructions section
test harness — validation rules for test expectations
DB query templates — per intent SQL
